target.title: fix(i18n): add missing Model Providers translations for all 20 locale files
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where non-English users would see untranslated English text throughout the Model Providers settings page (`/settings/model-providers`) when the UI language is set to any of 20 supported languages. Each locale file had 17–18 keys — including navigation labels, status indicators, and informational strings — that remained in English rather than the user's selected language, creating an inconsistent mixed-language experience.

## Why This Change Was Made

All untranslated `modelProviders` keys across 20 locale files were translated to their respective target languages, following the conventions already established by the surrounding translated sub-sections (`credentials`, `apiKey`, `probe`, `logout`, `add`, `defaults`, `readOnly`, `notes`). The deeply nested keys had been translated previously; this change fills in the top-level and status/info keys that were missed during initial localization.

## User Impact

Users of all 20 supported languages will see a fully localized Model Providers settings page, consistent with the rest of the settings UI. This covers the page title, subtitle, empty state messaging, connection status labels, credential expiry notifications, model counts, live usage stats, and session cost display.

## Evidence

| Language | File | Keys Translated |
|---|---|---|
| Arabic (العربية) | ar.ts | 18 |
| German (Deutsch) | de.ts | 18 |
| Spanish (Español) | es.ts | 18 |
| Persian (فارسی) | fa.ts | 18 |
| French (Français) | fr.ts | 18 |
| Hindi (हिन्दी) | hi.ts | 17* |
| Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) | id.ts | 18 |
| Italian (Italiano) | it.ts | 18 |
| Japanese (日本語) | ja-JP.ts | 18 |
| Korean (한국어) | ko.ts | 18 |
| Dutch (Nederlands) | nl.ts | 18 |
| Polish (Polski) | pl.ts | 18 |
| Portuguese / Brazil (Português) | pt-BR.ts | 18 |
| Russian (Русский) | ru.ts | 17* |
| Thai (ไทย) | th.ts | 18 |
| Turkish (Türkçe) | tr.ts | 18 |
| Ukrainian (Українська) | uk.ts | 18 |
| Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) | vi.ts | 18 |
| Simplified Chinese (简体中文) | zh-CN.ts | 18 |
| Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) | zh-TW.ts | 18 |

> *hi.ts and ru.ts: 17 keys each — the `refreshing` key was already translated prior to this change.

All existing translations in the nested sub-sections (`credentials`, `apiKey`, `probe`, `logout`, `add`, `defaults`, `readOnly`, `notes`) are unchanged — only the 18 previously-missing keys were filled in per language.
